description.value:
You draw upon the collective's memory of wildshaping to thicken your skin into the coarse, layered hide of a great beast. You gain 5 temporary Hit Points. While these temporary Hit Points remain, your hide hardens your exterior against glancing blows; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. Both benefits last until the spell ends or until the temporary Hit Points are depleted, whichever comes first.

Heightened (3rd) The temporary Hit Points increase to 10.

Heightened (5th) The temporary Hit Points increase to 15, and the circumstance bonus to AC increases to +2.

Heightened (7th) The temporary Hit Points increase to 25.

Heightened (9th) The temporary Hit Points increase to 35, and the circumstance bonus to AC increases to +3.
